item.description: Led by Asheville bassist and composer Quinn Sternberg, Mind Beach is known throughout the Carolinas for its adventurous improvisation and thoughtful songwriting. Drawing from Sternberg’s five studio albums alongside an ever-evolving repertoire, the band creates a fluid, genre-blurring sound that DownBeat Magazine praised as “complex yet digestible.” The quartet brings an energetic, deeply connected approach to every performance. Featuring: Quinn Sternberg – Bass Jacob Rodriguez – Saxophone Tim Fischer – Guitar Joe Enright – Drums & Special Guest: Chris Bullock Chris Bullock is a multi-instrumentalist, composer, and producer known for his work on saxophones, flutes, clarinets, and keyboards. Over the years, he has expanded his artistic voice through composition and music production, crafting a distinctive and continually evolving sound. item.title: Mt. Mitchell to Winter Star, 8.4mi, 2,900ft, Fitness Hike — Wed Aug 26, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group 8:45 for carpooling at the Bull Creek Valley Overlook on the Parkway OR 9:30 at the Mt. Mitchell picnic area/Black Mountain Crest Trailhead. ...If you sign up and change your mind even if on a waitlist, change your RSVP to "not attending" to free up your reservation.
Out and back: We will hike the Black Mountain Crest from the picnic area (lower parking lot) to Winter Star Mountain and back. Gorgeous vistas await.
PACE: All fitness hikes have a brisk steady pace (\~3 mi/hr), adjusting for trail conditions, and regrouping as needed. These hikes are specifically for conditioned hikers. Please be sure of your hiking ability before signing on. This hike includes some rock, rope, and ladder climbing.
CAR POOL: For those who wish to car pool, we will meet at the Bull Creek Valley Overlook on the Parkway. Tell the hike leader where you intend to meet the group: Bull Creek Overlook (8:45am) or Mt. Mitchell picnic area trailhead (9:30).

item.title: Plein Air Painting in the Gardens — Thu Sep 10, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Plein Air Painting in the Gardens with Erika Busse Thursday, September 10 | 9am – 11pm Register Here!
There is no better way to relax and connect with your creative side and nature than en plein air painting. In this class, artist Erika Busse will teach you how to paint an original Appalachian inspired artwork outside at the beautiful North Carolina Arboretum. She will take you through each step of the painting process, all skill levels are welcomed and all supplies are provided. This program will take place outside and will follow easy trails and paved walkways. Dress for the weather and prepare to be outside for the entire program time. Erika Busse moved to Asheville in 2017 after graduating from the University of Alabama with degrees in art and business. She is a small business owner of her full time artist business, sharing mountain inspired painting and printmaking with the world. She has been teaching plein air painting classes since 2021. ● Members: Remember to enter

Intention: TBA
## About CJ O'Reilly
CJ O'Reilly has been creating ecstatic dance waves for the Asheville community since 2014. Their eclectic mix of musical styles beckons dancers into new patterns of movement and expression through diverse time signatures and instrumentation, and a wide range of musical and emotive qualities. CJ's waves explore high peaks, beautiful vistas, juicy lowlands and the profound reflective stillness of tranquil water. CJ's dance waves are pre-produced and refined through the body and ears of a dancer and audiophile. Find more of DJ SeigeA's dance waves at [https://dj.seigea.com](https://dj.seigea.com) \~\~\~
